tasks.spec: Implement fizzbuzz in Python in ./fizzbuzz.py. The function signature must be exactly: def fizzbuzz(n: int) -> list[str]: Return list of strings for 1..n. Replace multiples of 3 with 'Fizz', multiples of 5 with 'Buzz', multiples of both 3 and 5 with 'FizzBuzz'. All other numbers as strings. Edge cases: n=0 returns [], n=1 returns ['1'], n=15 returns the full FizzBuzz sequence with 'FizzBuzz' at position 15, n=30 returns 30 elements. You may write additional tests in test_fizzbuzz_candidate.py if you wish, but admission is determined solely by the loop-owned reference suite (test_fizzbuzz_ref.py) which you will NOT see. Do NOT create conftest.py, pytest.ini, or any pytest configuration that could interfere with the reference suite. After implementing, run: python3 -m pytest test_fizzbuzz_ref.py -v 2>&1 | tee ./probation-pytest.txt. Write a JSON summary to ./smoke-result.json with: {"candidate_model": "<actual model used>", "exit_code": <int>, "passed": <bool>}.
tasks.check: REF_TEST=$(mktemp -d); cp /Users/hermes/ringer/templates/probation-smoke/test_fizzbuzz_ref.py $REF_TEST/; cp /Users/hermes/ringer/templates/probation-smoke/conftest_ref.py $REF_TEST/ 2>/dev/null; cp fizzbuzz.py $REF_TEST/; cd $REF_TEST; python3 -m pytest test_fizzbuzz_ref.py -v 2>&1 | tee ./probation-pytest.txt; EXIT=$?; rm -rf $REF_TEST; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo FAIL_EXIT; exit 1; fi; PASSED=$(grep -c 'PASSED' ./probation-pytest.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0); FAILED=$(grep -c 'FAILED\|ERROR' ./probation-pytest.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $PASSED -lt 4 ]; then echo FAIL_ONLY; exit 1; fi; if [ $FAILED -gt 0 ]; then echo FAIL_FAILED; exit 1; fi; echo PASS_OK
